blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — The principal of Isulan National High School in Sultan Kudarat province on Wednesday vehemently denied reports of a shooting or hostage-taking on campus, saying all students were safe following a security scare that prompted a lockdown. “There was no shooting incident, and there was no hostage-taking,” school principal Lorna Lee Ann Valencia said, addressing what she described as misinformation circulating about the incident. Valencia said police arrived at the school within five minutes and helped contain the situation and ease concerns among students and school personnel.
